eyebrow: College Station, TX · Asian Grocery · Texas Ave & Harvey Mitchell
lead: BCS Asian Market at 2704 Texas Ave S, at Texas Ave and Harvey Mitchell Pkwy, carries Asian groceries, produce, snacks and pantry staples. Texas A&M's international student office lists it as a go-to. 4.1 stars from 980 Google reviews.
svc_text: Typical Asian grocery categories. BCS Asian Market would confirm stock.
about: BCS Asian Market is at 2704 Texas Ave S in College Station, at the intersection of Texas Ave and Harvey Mitchell Parkway.
Texas A&M's International Student & Scholar Services lists it as a local grocery for students, and The Battalion has noted the need for a store like it given the area's large Asian community.
Customers have given it 4.1 stars across 980 Google reviews.
